backtest._note: Horizons are 60 and 120 sessions because the book holds for weeks to quarters. Excess return vs SPY after every past signal, all stocks pooled, signals at least 20 sessions apart per stock, results trimmed at the baseline's 1st/99th percentile. edge = signal mean minus ordinary-day mean. t_clustered treats each calendar month as one observation. WORKS = clustered t of 2 or more and positive in both halves. by_condition splits each archetype by whether SPY was above its 200-day and whether the stock's sector was beating SPY on the signal day: a condition is a candidate filter only if its edge and t are clearly better than the other side. Still uncorrected: survivorship (today's index members only, which flatters anything that buys a fallen stock), no stops, no costs.

notes: Prices are raw split-adjusted closes (dividends not added back). ranked[] simulates each setup's own stop, target and 60-session time stop on the stock's 10-year history, against the same trade taken on any day (the drift). Estimates and earnings dates are from Yahoo when available. MACRO_PUNISHED names no driver; research must. v16 (14 Nov 2026): the $60 stock price cap and the TOO EXPENSIVE tier are gone (book rule changed 2 Nov 2026: no stock price limit, the instrument stays a deep in-the-money call). Affordability now uses the real option: the chosen call's ask x 100 against SLOT_USD $2,000 and SLOT_STRETCH $2,700; above the stretch the tier is kept but fits_slot is false and the instrument is shares or a smaller position; no chain data means fits_slot null. Market cap floor $5B (Yahoo marketCap, cache up to 10 days) applies to today's candidates only; backtests, survivorship and lens tests keep their existing universes, because today's market cap applied to history would be look-ahead. Option deltas are Black-Scholes with a 4% rate and dividends ignored; see options.json for the selection rules.
